title: Color Theme
details: Choose Dark, Light, or custom colors for the site.

modes.title: Dark
modes.details: Black page with dark gray tiles, like the iOS dark grid.

modes.title: Light
modes.details: White tiles on a light gray page, like the iOS light grid.

modes.title: Custom
modes.details: Choose the page, section, and panel colors yourself.

liquidGlass.title: Liquid Glass
liquidGlass.details: Frosted, translucent surfaces inspired by Apple Liquid Glass.

options.title: On
options.details: Enable blur, translucency, and a light glass edge.

options.title: Off
options.details: Keep solid backgrounds without the glass effect.
